verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI supports session/cookie reuse via Browser Profiler (persistent auth states/cookies) and general 'session re-use' in Advanced Browser Control, which enables fetching authenticated pages. However, community feedback explicitly flags login/session handling as a 'boring production bit' developers must own themselves, and there's no explicit doc example passing custom cookies programmatically via arun(). Missing for 10: a concrete first-party example of passing custom session cookies into arun(), independent hands-on confirmation of authenticated fetch working reliably.
